headline: Newsroom Brief Previews Week 4 of Senate Impeachment Proceedings
seoDescription: An FMB News overnight brief says the Senate impeachment trial enters its fourth week on August 17, with prosecution witnesses expected to focus on confidential-fund disbursement records.
deck: The overnight newsroom package says prosecution witnesses are expected to focus on confidential-fund disbursement records as the trial enters another week.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Senate of the Philippines is handling Impeachment Case No. 004-2026, and the official Senate impeachment-document portal remains active for the prosecution and defense records in the case.

The August 17 FMB News overnight brief reports that the court is entering its fourth week and that former disbursing officers or cash custodians are expected to be presented by the prosecution in connection with confidential-fund disbursement records. The brief cites a Manila Times item published for August 17. Because FMB News did not independently retrieve a current Senate PRIB advisory confirming the exact witness order, start time, or all witness descriptions, those details remain source-attributed rather than stated as independently verified facts.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The Senate's official impeachment-document page confirms the active case and provides the formal prosecution and defense filings. The overnight witness preview is treated separately as a newsroom-source report until the matching Senate session advisory or transcript is available.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Witnesses who handled disbursement records can be important to the evidentiary record because they may clarify how documents, cash advances, liquidation papers, and acknowledgments were processed. Their testimony should not be treated as proof of liability before examination and cross-examination are completed.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch the Senate's official impeachment records and session coverage for the confirmed witness lineup, actual testimony, evidentiary rulings, and any changes to the day's schedule.
